results.title: Psychology says people often defend decisions they once made even after the reasons disappear
results.description: Psychology suggests that the real challenge is not making decisions we will never regret. It is developing enough psychological flexibility to recognize when an old justification has stopped serving us, and allowing ourselves to choose differently without treating that change as an admission that we were foolish all along.

results.title: Brahmaputra floods in Assam to moderate as hydropower projects rise in Tibet, Arunachal Pradesh: Himanta Biswa Sarma
results.description: In a proactive move, Assam's Chief Minister highlighted the importance of using hydropower projects from Tibet and Arunachal to mitigate flood issues. He mentioned the government's intention to investigate the funds raised by 72 YouTubers for flood relief as well. Prime Minister Modi has promised federal support for rehabilitation efforts following the flood damage assessments. The state is releasing funds to repair anganwadi centres and plans to assist flood-affected namghars.
